Trigger warning: This article mentions incident involving a child

A child died in a fire that affected a residential area in Pasay City on Friday night, according to GMA Integrated News reporter Jhomer Apresto.

The BFP said since the houses were made of light materials and were built close to each other, the fire quickly escalated, necessitating declaring the third alarm.

The fire reportedly started on the second floor of a house.

The BFP is still conducting an investigation to determine the cause of the fire and provide an estimate of the cost of property damage.

READ: https://t.co/vMdQnpwg9g
